result.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
result.summary: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Jeveration，在冻结的视觉语言模型上复用视觉语义知识，通过让所有位置条件于同一共享随机状态来协调并行预测，实现单次前向的高质量图像生成，并把 text-to-image、image-to-image 与 dense prediction 统一到一个 checkpoint。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用共享随机状态约束并行预测以维持全局一致性」及「先学离散码分布以缓解模型忽略该状态」的做法，可能为并行式 latent 推理中的状态协调与潜变量被旁路问题提供可核查的方法线索，但任务本身是图像生成，需读原文确认。
